def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(flat), key=flat.count)
    hrules = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    vrules = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rbounds = [-1] + hrules + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vrules + [w]
    panels = [(rbounds[ri] + 1, rbounds[ri+1], cbounds[ci] + 1, cbounds[ci+1])
              for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1) for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    panels = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1]
    def cells(panel):
        r0,r1,c0,c1 = panel
        return [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(v != bg for row in cells(p) for v in row))
    pattern = cells(source)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            for dc in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
